about_the_game:
Dew is an atmospheric 2.5D platformer adventure set in a realistic micro-environment. As a mysterious creeping mold is destroying and corrupting the living, two tiny heroes, Myric and Dewey join forces to stop it and the source of evil behind it.

Game Features

  • Single player or Co-op. Play with a less experienced player and let them "ride with you" through the more challenging parts.

  • Classic side-scrolling platformer with recognizable controls. Dodge, dash, double jump, slide and hang glide your way through the dangerous paths.

  • Unlock powerful new skills to traverse uncharted paths and confront even greater dangers.

  •  Explore a variety of beautiful levels, accompanied by an atmospheric score.

Exploration

Explore a world inspired by the beauty of nature seen from a macro perspective, find secret paths and earn rewards.

Symbiotic Skills

  • Utilize the symbiotic skills of Myric and Dewey to traverse the world and overpower enemies.

  • Overpower and cure the cute, yet creepy characters infected by the dangerous creeping mold.

Maintaining the Balance

  • Earn perks by solving puzzles to restore the environment or help characters in need.

  • Collect magic dew drops and send them through the mycelium network that maintains the balance in the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred), HDD (Supported)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 (3.2Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or INTEL Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD (Preferred), HDD (Supported)

short_description: Dew is a 1-2 player Co-op Adventure with classic 2D Platformer mechanics set in a stunningly beautiful realistic micro-environment. Play as two tiny unlikely heroes, Myric and Dewey and stop the evil forces that is spreading a creeping mold that is infecting all living in their world.
